ios-actions|Activity views.summary: The activity view (the share sheet) is a system surface: iOS draws it in its own look in every app, so Plenix does not restyle it. The Plenix part is what the app controls: the standard Share button in the Plenix button style that opens it, the items it shares, the system activities it excludes, and custom activities with a Plenix symbol and a short verb-phrase title. Apple’s default and the Plenix version therefore look the same inside the sheet.
